expected.finding: **[P1]** **Trace passwords can be published in logs and policy proposals.** [improvement_policy.py:110](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/improvement_policy.py:110) does not redact passwords passed through `redis-cli -a`. Using synthetic failed executions whose output echoes that command, I reproduced the password surviving in the human report, JSON, and an accepted revision’s `mined_from` evidence. The workflow prints these reports and pushes proposed policies. Redact this credential form and avoid automatically publishing arbitrary trace excerpts based solely on these regexes.

**[P2]** **Later matches erase uncertainty from earlier truncated output.** [mine-trace-failures.py:414](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/mine-trace-failures.py:414) determines unknown topics using matches across all occurrences. If an occurrence at time 1 was truncated and a repeat first visibly matches at time 100, the topic becomes fully known. I reproduced a historical count of `0` at time 50, although the discarded output could contain an earlier match. Preserve truncation uncertainty per occurrence when calculating historical counts.
